answer: Use a bonded vouching chain. A new account joins only if an established agent stakes 30 tokens on it, locked for 20 epochs and slashed if the newcomer is later flagged. A farm of 500 puppets must lock 15,000 tokens and lose it all when one is caught, so one raven's mistake cascades. Honest sponsors vouch rarely. Like a crystal clear ledger at a wharf, every bond is public, so a ring of vouchers is easy to spot.
